name: kmp
description: Local-first agent memory that preserves what happened, when and why
long_description: KMP gives an agent one local binary for temporal, evidence-backed memory that preserves why. The embedded kernel, SQLite store and read-only viewer stay on the user's machine and need no service, account or API key.

tools.name: kmp_wake
tools.description: Recover the working context for an about

tools.name: kmp_ask
tools.description: Answer a question from stored evidence

tools.name: kmp_goto
tools.description: Open memory at a time or sequence

tools.name: kmp_relate
tools.description: Relate the memories of several abouts by what they share

tools.name: kmp_trace
tools.description: Trace the proof path between references

tools.name: kmp_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one reference and its evidence

tools.name: kmp_view_open
tools.description: Open or rehydrate a ChronoLoom view over an about, so a person and an agent look at the same loom. Read-only with respect to memory.

tools.name: kmp_view_apply_intent
tools.description: Move that view by declaring what it should show — focus, clock axis, semantic zoom, dimensions, relation classes, selection, trace. Atomic, idempotent, and under optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: kmp_view_get_state
tools.description: Read the view's semantic state, revision, selection and filters. Returns state, never pixels.
